title: oozy croatian boudin-noir dum
description: floral, gooey, solo-dinner croatian dish featuring boudin-noir, dum, lacto-vegetarian-friendly. enjoy the combination of rich black sausage and comforting dumplings in a flavorful broth
instructions: combine the sautéed black sausage and dumplings in a large skillet over medium heat
add 2 cups of vegetable broth to the skillet and stir to combine
bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally
serve the oozy croatian boudin-noir dum hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired
meanwhile, prepare the dum pastry according to package instructions
if using homemade dumplings, wrap them in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use
if using store-bought pastry, thaw according to package instructions
once the dumplings are ready, fry them in a skillet with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil until golden brown
set the fried dumplings aside on a paper towel-lined plate
when the black sausage is cooked through, remove it from the heat and let it cool slightly
wrap the cooled black sausage in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use
once the sausage is chilled, slice it into 1-inch pieces, discarding any excess fat and visible connective tissue
heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
add the sliced black sausage to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides and crispy on the bottom
remove the browned black sausage from the skillet and set it aside on a paper towel-lined plate
add another 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet and stir to combine
add the prepared dumplings to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are browned on all sides and crispy on the bottom
add the cooked black sausage back into the skillet with the dumplings and stir to combine
add 2 cups of vegetable broth to the skillet and stir to combine
bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally
serve the oozy croatian boudin-noir dum hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired
